description: Toggle a plugin's enabled state in both the persisted per-plugin config and the live orchestrator. Writes the boolean to profile/config/plugins/<plugin_name>.json (creating the file when absent) and then mutates the running roster: when enabling, the plugin is loaded via the plugin manager's entry-point discovery if it is not already present and its services are started when it implements the LifecycleManaged protocol; when disabling, the plugin's services are stopped first, the plugin is removed from the live roster, and the process registry is refreshed via knowledge_service::refresh_plugin_processes so its action keys disappear from discovery. The persisted boolean survives a homunculus restart, so a single call makes the enable/disable decision both immediate and durable. The verb does NOT delete the plugin's Python module from sys.modules — re-enabling reuses any already-loaded module objects, only re-instantiating the plugin class. Returns restart_required=true only when the enable path discovered the plugin's entry-point is not installed at all; the disable path always applies in-process.
embedding_description: Toggle a plugin enabled/disabled live without restart. Writes the bool to profile/config/plugins/<plugin>.json AND mutates the runtime roster: stop_services + drop from active set on disable; load + start_services on enable. Refreshes process registry so action keys appear/disappear. Returns restart_required=true only when enabling an uninstalled plugin (use install_plugin_from_path first).

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Toggle result with keys: applied (bool, true when the runtime state change took effect this session), restart_required (bool, true when only the persisted change took effect and a restart is needed to fully apply), plugin_name (str), message (str status detail).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: On a successful disable, confirm the plugin's services were stopped and its process keys removed from discovery. On a successful enable, confirm services are started and process keys are visible. If restart_required is true, surface the reason — typically the plugin's entry-point was not installed when enabling — so the caller knows to install or restart.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: After a successful disable, do not invoke the plugin's process keys again in the same flow; they have been unregistered. After a successful enable, list_plugins can confirm the new status and process_count. If restart_required is true, install_plugin_from_path is the in-session path to bring an uninstalled plugin online; otherwise restart the homunculus.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Toggle a plugin on or off in both persisted config and the live orchestrator's roster
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: plugin_name was empty or enabled was not a bool. ConfigManagerUnavailable: the orchestrator's config manager attribute is missing (indicates startup did not complete). PluginManagerUnavailable: the orchestrator's plugin_manager attribute is missing. LifecycleStartFailure: start_services raised during the enable path; the plugin's services may be in an inconsistent state. LifecycleStopFailure: stop_services raised during the disable path; the plugin's services may not have shut down cleanly.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For missing plugin_name: provide the entry-point name. For unavailable manager errors: do not retry — the platform is in an inconsistent startup state and a restart is the correct recovery. For LifecycleStart/StopFailure: inspect logs for the underlying cause (config drift, missing dependency, port collision) before retrying.
